about.body_1: I'm an AI product manager with 4 commercialized AI products shipped from 0 to 1, covering enterprise Agent, RAG knowledge base, and SaaS platform patterns. Data-driven iteration, cross-functional alignment, end-to-end delivery — 50+ user research sessions, 15 data analysis reports, 200+ competitor analyses, all funnelled into PRDs that ship.
about.body_2: Latest three flagship products: WDA — enterprise workflow-discovery Agent SaaS (decision-style Agent + 3-tier evidence scoring); JobHunter — enterprise AI recruiting Agent (multi-turn dialog + pgvector + 5-stage Agent chain, live paid users); OPC — one-prompt full-stack app generator (6-role Agent loop + multi-tenant isolation).
about.body_3: An AI-era PM has to answer three questions: direction, delivery, distribution. WDA answers direction (7-day MVP + ROI), OPC answers delivery (multi-agents that actually run the MVP), MediaPilot answers distribution (getting the product seen). Beyond the trilogy, Lumora / JobHunter / Poker GTO continue iterating on their own commercial paths.
